name: SWE-Sharp-Bench
intro: SWE-Sharp-Bench 是一个面向 C#/.NET 的可复现软件工程基准，包含 17 个真实仓库中的 150 个 Issue 解决任务。构建流程从高星活跃仓库与已合并测试 PR 出发，自动解析工作流、解决方案和项目文件生成 Docker 环境，经基线/测试补丁/修复补丁三状态执行与两位作者复核后，使用 C# 专用提示词、单次两小时尝试和全部测试通过条件评测智能体。
build_method: C# PR 挖掘、.NET Docker 自动构建、三状态执行过滤、双人复核
eval_feature: C#/.NET、多测试框架、容器化可复现执行
scale: 150 个 Issue 解决任务，17 个 C# 仓库
build_method_en: C# PR Mining, Automated .NET Docker Construction, Three-State Execution Filtering, Dual Review
eval_feature_en: C#/.NET, Multiple Test Frameworks, Reproducible Container Execution
intro_en: SWE-Sharp-Bench is a reproducible C#/.NET software-engineering benchmark with 150 issue-resolution tasks from 17 real repositories. It selects high-star active repositories and merged test-changing pull requests, automatically derives Docker environments from workflow, solution, and project files, applies base/test/fix three-state execution and two-author review, then evaluates agents with C#-adapted prompts, one valid two-hour attempt, and an all-tests-pass criterion.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2511.02352 Sections III-A and IV plus Appendix B. The diagram preserves the top-100, 5,000-star, six-month activity, and build-viability repository filters; 1,000 latest PRs per repository with issue, test-file, and merge requirements; automated .NET Docker construction from workflow, solution, project, environment, and global configuration; base/test/test-plus-fix pass-fail-pass execution; and two-author checks for underspecified statements and inadequate tests. Evaluation uses C#-adapted SWE-Agent/OpenHands prompts, one valid attempt, a two-hour timeout, normalized NUnit/XUnit/MSTest logs, and all-tests-pass Resolution Rate.
